svg.title: TheVoidJulius commit city
svg.desc: A tilted isometric city grid for January through December 2026. November is highlighted; the next two months are reserved as flat land. Building height scales with daily commits through 2026-11-04, with 50 commits reaching the skyline cap.
svg.text: THE CITY I BUILT THIS YEAR
JAN → DEC 2026 / NOVEMBER FOCUS / NEXT TWO MONTHS RESERVED AS FLAT LAND
50 COMMITS = TALLEST BUILDING · HOVER FOR EXACT COUNTS
